headline: Modest growth as refinancing costs weigh on profit
summary_short: Hayward Holdings' Q2 2026 revenue rose 6.3% y/y to $318.4M on positive net pricing and favorable FX, while gross margin slipped 50bp to 48.7% on tariff-driven cost inflation and net income grew 1.8% y/y to $45.6M despite a $1.8M debt-extinguishment charge from a June refinancing.
summary_long: Net sales grew 6.3% y/y to $318.4M on positive net price to offset inflation and tariffs plus favorable foreign-currency translation; volume was roughly flat. Gross margin slipped 50bp to 48.7% as tariff-driven cost inflation outpaced price gains. SG&A rose on higher incentive compensation; operating income and net income both grew, aided by a lower effective tax rate (23.0% vs 24.6%). The company refinanced its term loans in June ($960M new facility), incurring $5.2M of financing costs and a $1.8M debt-extinguishment loss, lifting net interest expense 24% y/y. Diluted EPS rose 5.0% to $0.21, helped by continued buybacks ($58.0M repurchased in the quarter). No dividend was paid. No forward guidance was disclosed in this filing.

drivers.explanation: Net sales rose on positive net price to offset inflation and tariffs plus favorable foreign-currency translation; volume was roughly flat (-0.1pp of the 6.3% increase).
Gross profit dollars grew with revenue, but margin fell 50bp as cost-of-sales inflation from tariffs outpaced the positive net price impact.
Grew from higher gross profit plus lower acquisition/restructuring expense and lower intangible amortization, partly offset by higher SG&A from increased incentive compensation.
Tracked the operating income increase and a lower effective tax rate (23.0% vs 24.6%) on lower state taxes, partly offset by higher net interest expense from the June refinancing.
Diluted EPS grew faster than net income as continued share buybacks (4.1M shares this quarter) reduced the diluted share count year over year.
Basic EPS held at $0.21 as the modest 1.8% net income gain did not clear the rounding threshold; basic weighted-average share count was nearly unchanged y/y.

Steady price-led revenue growth and cost discipline lifted profit modestly, but a June term-loan refinancing added one-time debt-extinguishment and financing costs; no dividend or forward guidance was disclosed.
